description: This file defines a Java class `LoanProductsRequestFactory` used to generate various pre-configured loan product request objects for testing purposes within the Apache Fineract project. It contains methods that return `PostLoanProductsRequest` objects, each representing different loan product configurations, used to facilitate testing different loan scenarios.

classes.name: LoanProductsRequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class for generating various loan product request objects with preset configurations, used in testing different loan scenarios in the Fineract project.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1
methods.description: Creates a default loan product request with typical parameters for a basic loan type.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1InterestFlat
methods.description: Creates a loan product request configured with flat interest rate terms.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1InterestDeclining
methods.description: Creates a loan product request with declining balance interest rate settings.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1InterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingMonthly
methods.description: Creates a declining balance interest loan product with daily interest recalculation and monthly compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1InterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingNone
methods.description: Creates a declining balance interest loan with daily interest recalculation and no compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2InterestDailyRecalculation
methods.description: Creates a loan with interest recalculated daily.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2InterestFlat
methods.description: Creates a second type of loan with flat interest rate terms.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2InterestDeclining
methods.description: Creates a declining balance interest loan with specific configuration.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2InterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingMonthly
methods.description: Declining balance interest loan with daily recalculations and monthly compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2InterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingNone
methods.description: Declining balance interest loan with daily recalculations and no compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP11MonthInterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingMonthly
methods.description: Loan with a specific 11-month declining balance interest recalculation setup with monthly compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP1InterestDecliningBalanceDailyRecalculationCompoundingNone
methods.description: Duplicate of earlier method, creates declining balance loan with daily recalculation and no compounding.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2Emi
methods.description: Creates a loan request with EMI schedule, interest calculations, and detailed account mappings for LP2 EMI loans.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2EmiWithChargeOff
methods.description: Creates an EMI loan request with charge-off reasons and mappings, including detailed account and charge configurations.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2ChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Creates a loan request with specific charge-off reasons mapped to expense accounts, with buy-down fees.

methods.name: generateShortNameSafely
methods.description: Generates a unique short name avoiding duplicates using a configured map and random generator.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2EmiCashAccounting
methods.description: Creates an EMI loan request configured for cash-based accounting, with detailed account, charge, and fee settings.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2CapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Creates a loan request with capitalized income, deferred income accounts, and interest capitalization settings.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2EmiCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Creates an EMI loan request with capitalized income and interest capitalization enabled.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2ChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappingsWithCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Creates a loan request with charge-off reasons, expense mappings, and capitalized income options enabled.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2BuyDownFees
methods.description: Creates a loan request including buy-down fees, detailed account and charge configurations, and EMI schedule.

methods.name: defaultLoanProductsRequestLP2ChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappingsWithBuyDownFee
methods.description: Creates a loan request including charge-off reasons, expense mappings, buy-down fee configurations, and interest recalculations.
